messages:
Sam (People Ops): Quick drop  micro pack for setting one "stretch" goal + tight feedback anchors. Copy/paste friendly.

Vera (Eng Manager): Love concise packs. can we make a 1-line goal template and a 1-line manager opener?

Sam (People Ops): Yep  kept both to one line each. Added a 2-bullet self-review prompt and a short calibration paste.

PeopleOps-Bot: Reminder: performance window opens in 2 days  see /perf for timeline.

Sam (People Ops): [STRETCH GOAL + FEEDBACK ANCHORS]
1) 2-min manager prep:
- Scan self-review bullets (2) + pick one artifact link. Decide provisional rating.

2) One-line stretch goal template (SMART-lite):
- "Obj: [outcome]. Stretch KR: [metric + %/target]. Timebox: [quarter]. Owner: [name]."

3) Self-review 2-bullet prompt (send to ICs):
- Bullet 1: "What I shipped (outcome + metric/link)."
- Bullet 2: "One thing I tried that didn't work + what I learned."
(<=160 chars each)

4) Manager opener (read in 1:1, one line):
- "Thanks  quick win then one skill to practice next cycle; let's land one concrete action."

5) Calibration paste (one line per person):
- "Name / Level / Provisional: Above/On-target/Below / 1-line evidence / Main caveat"
Example: "Owen / SWE II / On-target / launched async cache, -20% cost / Caveat: rollout only 20% traffic"

6) Feedback anchors (short descriptors for calibration):
- Above: Repeatedly expanded scope, measurable impact, coached others.
- On-target: Met defined outcomes with solid execution.
- Below: Missed expected outcomes or unreliable delivery.

7) Quick coaching nudge (pasteable into 1:1 notes):
- "Agree 1 practice to try, owner, and a 2-week check-in date."

Vera (Eng Manager): Perfect. the "one thing that didn't work" prompt is great for growth talks. I'll use this for my team.

Owen (SWE): Can we make the calibration paste include a link to the metric dashboard? helps reviewers.

Sam (People Ops): Good call  add a trailing field: "/dash link" in the paste. Will update the kickoff doc and drop this into the manager playbook.

PeopleOps-Bot: Note: manager playbook updated at https://redwood.internal/playbooks/manager - new templates added.

Sam (People Ops): Thanks all  DM me if you want a slide or slightly different wording for your org. :thumbsup:"
